latest_message:
Dear Aida,

Thank you for your message. I appreciate your patience as we confirm
receipt of your feedback.

Rest assured, we have received your previous messages, and I’m thrilled to
hear that you had such a positive interview experience. Your insights are
invaluable to us as we continue to enhance our platform.

Let us know if you have any questions,

Best regards,

*Jessica from Flowmingo Customer Support Team*
